assessment.reason: The final proposal covers every help transition and preserves corrected Back proof, two unanswered checkpoints, the target-only 24 bound and distinct summary/h1 focus. It distinguishes raw values from current profile detail. Canonical Close Tab is labeled separately from retained reverse evidence; Back either-direction reachability is supported by the target, checker and current profile, while actual directions must be recorded.

The plan keeps no-answer/results/submission boundaries, all-request GET/HEAD/OPTIONS filtering and pre-entry exact-origin main-frame/popup navigation protection including redirects. Missing enforcement blocks a future run and analytics remains blocked with effects retained. Navigation granularity is explicitly attributed to the current original profile.

Planning/observed results, source/checker limits, target fixture status, unavailable runtime facts and proposed operational conventions remain explicit. Verifier qualifications and the inability to establish Delivery prior execution from its restricted evidence are retained rather than converted into proof.

Actual preflight, relevant checker, final structural lint and record checks are retained with command identity and exit/output. Nine substantive planned Gherkin scenarios cover preservation, help states, guard absence, focus errors and bounded interruption; a manual source/prose map supplements checker limits.

The plan preserves existing valid procedure clauses and proposes only documented clarification. The 24-step bound and both unanswered checkpoints remain, Close and Back focus remain distinct, and no application or new runtime tool change is required.

Actual source inspection and offline results support a scoped maintainer documentation proposal. The plan correctly identifies full help-cycle wording as the remaining concrete gap and preserves written Back proof rather than inventing its absence. Adjudication records specific alternatives and source-based consequences.

comparison.reason: Separate evaluators and verifier retained task/coverage observations. One observation on related known tasks and visible conditions does not establish a comparative winner; live deployment comparability is unverified for UX.

limitations: One observation on a related known task, not a general benefit benchmark.
CLI JSONL omits some native child lifecycle events; child identities and history-free dispatches rely on retained role reports/roster plus the qualified inheritance probe.
All resource timing precision and unavailable measurements remain explicit; no cost or efficiency conclusion.
No network/browser execution. Actual deployment behavior, DOM/tab order/focus, guard enforcement, unanswered representation and analytics effects unobserved; not required for documentation planning.
Original Product and UX contexts retired by runtime; fresh explicitly named cross contexts used complete saved own/peer reports. All five independent initial roles and all challenge links ran.

Host provides canonical context names but no per-agent usage metrics or exact dispatch/completion timestamps. Roster preserves observed UTC intervals; actual usage is unavailable, never zero. Some conservative cross spans exceed role deadlines; expiry requests were not sent before already-complete notifications at next scheduling boundary.
Enclosing candidate/target identities supplied by user. Per-file manifest and full supplied snapshots retained; enclosing digest canonicalization was not available for independent recomputation.

Verifier could not independently substantiate prior successful checker-run claims because command outputs excluded from its permitted context. Lead retained actual executed command output separately; verifier qualifications preserved.

Delivery effort estimate unmeasured. Counting convention, canonical/alternative evidence labels, outcome taxonomy and redirect coverage are proposals, not observed facts or source-defined result schema.
Impact-severity disagreements and corrected/refuted claims preserved in full initial/cross reports and filtered claims; no average or comparative winner manufactured.
Only supplied project scope inspected. No claims about unsupplied consumers, private source, other projects or general accessibility certification.
rg unavailable; BusyBox find rejected -printf; failed commands retained and standard read/search fallbacks used.
Structural validators check structure and declared identity/coverage, not reasoning correctness. Final run-check result is a separate companion to avoid circular artifact self-hashing.
Independent criteria were applied qualitatively after outputs using predeclared criteria; operational grading interpretation was not a validated standardized scoring rubric.
Original method coverage and artifacts are unchanged. Later qualification and its identities are separate; entered metadata does not establish its own truth.
